pages.label: Kaiseki dinner
pages.html:
Home/Kaiseki dinner

会席

Eight courses, one tray at a time. The menu follows the week, so this list is only a guide.

  1. 先付

    Sakizuke

    A single bite to open: sesame tofu with fresh wasabi.

  2. 椀物

    Wanmono

    Clear soup with river fish and yuzu peel.

  3. 造り

    Tsukuri

    Sashimi of the day, cut thick and eaten with local salt.

  4. 焼物

    Yakimono

    Grilled trout, charcoal, one bay leaf.

  5. 煮物

    Nimono

    Simmered vegetables from the hill garden.

  6. 御飯

    Gohan

    Terrace rice cooked in an iron pot, with pickles and miso soup.

  7. 水菓子

    Mizugashi

    Seasonal fruit and a small sweet; matcha or roasted tea.

pages.label: Onsen
pages.html:
Home/Onsen

温泉

One spring, three baths, used by turns so you are rarely sharing.

The water

Soft, slightly alkaline spring at 42°C, drawn from beneath the ridge. Good for the skin; best taken slowly, twice a day.

BathHours
Hinoki indoor06:00 – 23:00
Rock outdoor06:00 – 09:00 · 15:00 – 23:00
Private (book)Hourly, 45 min
Before you enter
  1. 一

    Wash first

    Sit and wash completely before entering the bath.

  2. 二

    Towel stays out

    Keep the small towel on your head or on the rim, not in the water.

  3. 三

    Tattoos welcome

    Private baths are available and tattoos are fine in all of them.

pages.html:
Home/Four seasons

四季

The inn is a different place in each season. Choose the one you want to remember.

春

Haru · Mar–May

Plum then cherry along the stream. Bamboo shoots on the menu.

夏

Natsu · Jun–Aug

Fireflies, river fish, screens open.

秋

Aki · Sep–Nov

Moon-viewing nights, mushrooms, maples.

冬

Fuyu · Dec–Feb

Snow, hot pot, the bath at its best.

pages.label: FAQ
pages.html:
Home/FAQ

よくある質問

Do you serve vegetarian dinner?

Yes. Tell us at booking; we change the menu rather than remove dishes.

Are children welcome?

From age 8, to keep the evenings quiet.

Is there a phone signal?

Weak in the valley. The inn has Wi-Fi in the lounge only.

Cancellation?

Free until 7 days before. After that, 50% of the first night.
